<tr><td>

[ResolvableCollectionReferenceData](./contracts.resolvablecollectionreferencedata.md)

</td><td>

Data of a collection reference to `Resources` that a client can resolve: the resource has `list`<!-- -->, its container (for a selector collection) has `get`<!-- -->, and for an identity collection the resource also has `get`<!-- -->, through which each entry resolves. A selector collection carries the identity container of its `list`<!-- -->'s parent, and each entry that of its `get`<!-- -->'s parent, when the operation records one.

</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[ResolvableContainmentOf](./contracts.resolvablecontainmentof.md)

</td><td>

The containment rule of reference data to resource `Key` resolved through `Operation`<!-- -->: the parent's identity container ([ResolvableParentContainment](./contracts.resolvableparentcontainment.md)<!-- -->) when that operation records a parent, and an optional resolvable container ([ResolvableContainment](./contracts.resolvablecontainment.md)<!-- -->) otherwise. A container resolves through its own resource's `get`<!-- -->, so its containment is read with `'get'` at every level.

</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[ResolvableObjectReferenceData](./contracts.resolvableobjectreferencedata.md)

</td><td>

Data of a single-object reference to `Resources` that a client can resolve: the resource has `get`<!-- -->, and so does that of every container, at every level, and a resource whose `get` records a parent carries that parent's identity container.

</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[ResolvableReferenceData](./contracts.resolvablereferencedata.md)

</td><td>

Data of any reference to `Resources` that a client can resolve: a target, containers, and entries that each record their resolving operation.

</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[ResolvableResourceKey](./contracts.resolvableresourcekey.md)

</td><td>

</td></tr>
